purpose: Set a completed action as the basis for a next step, or name the aspect being considered.
keywords: Verb past form + 上で; verb dictionary form + 上で; noun + の上で
Please sign after checking the contents.
Good health is important in working life.
On the map, the station looks close.
formation: Verb past form + 上で; verb dictionary form + 上で; noun + の上で
restrictions: Past + 上で means after doing; dictionary form + 上で means in doing or for doing.
mistake: Changing the verb tense changes the relation, not just the timeline.
